name: com.saturnreturnchart/saturn-return
title: Saturn Return Chart — Ephemeris Saturn Return Calculator
description: Calculate exact Saturn Return dates, conjunction passes, and Saturn zodiac sign transits.

tools.name: calculate_saturn_return
tools.description: Compute natal Saturn zodiac sign, ecliptic degree, optional natal house, and exact First, Second, and Third Saturn Return transit windows (start/end dates, exact conjunction passes with retrograde flags, sign season, and age) from ephemeris calculations (1900-2100).

birthDate.description: Birth date in YYYY-MM-DD format (1900 to today), e.g. '1996-06-14'.

birthTime.description: Optional 24-hour local birth time in HH:mm format, e.g. '08:30'. Omit if unknown.

timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone name for birthTime and formatted dates, e.g. 'America/Chicago' or 'UTC'.

latitude.description: Optional birth latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to 90). Provide with longitude, timezone, and birthTime to compute natal Saturn house.

longitude.description: Optional birth longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180). Provide with latitude, timezone, and birthTime to compute natal Saturn house.

orb.description: Optional orb in degrees for the Saturn Return window (1, 2, 3, 5, 8, or 10). Defaults to 5 degrees.

asOfDate.description: Optional reference date (YYYY-MM-DD) for classifying returns as past, active, or upcoming. Defaults to today (UTC).

tools.name: get_saturn_sign_transit
tools.description: Look up Saturn's exact tropical zodiac sign, degree, daily motion, and retrograde status on any date (1900-2100), and/or list Saturn's transit stay windows (1930-2095) for a specific zodiac sign.

date.description: Optional UTC calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format (1900-2100) to inspect Saturn's exact position. Defaults to today if neither date nor sign is provided.

sign.description: Optional zodiac sign slug (e.g. 'aries', 'pisces') to list all Saturn stays in that sign (1930-2095) and current transit status.
